propositions: A new parameterized test harness in tests/external/ must measure raw output distributions across LLM provider cells (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI) and directive variants (current vs sentinel) via workflow_dispatch job with per-provider secret scoping and call-budget enforcement.
The sentinel directive should increase parse success rate and collapse output layout to 100% prose format on Anthropic and Bedrock providers, eliminating fenced/multi-object layouts.

Scorer must deterministically parse and classify raw replies from committed E2 fixtures against both current and new selection+sentinel parsers, with golden-count unit tests validating exact reproduction of expected metrics.
Missing API credentials for a provider cell must be recorded as 'unmeasured' and skipped without job failure; this behavior is unit-testable in isolation.
Call-budget cap (default 300 calls/run, configurable via workflow input) must be enforced before any network call to prevent excessive API usage.
